payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of the development of the conceptual model in Figure 2 through thematic analysis and participant feedback.

claims.text: The conceptual model in Figure 2 was developed through a six-phase thematic analysis that organized and described themes from focus group discussions (FGDs) regarding gamified learning and recycling intention.
The model reflects insights from participants about their engagement and motivations influenced by gamification elements, such as competition and social influence.
The development of the model was also informed by the need to verify and enrich the conceptual framework based on participant responses and thematic analysis results.
